facts.business: Beryl Drugs Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and sale of pharmaceutical products.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgment in estimating variable consideration including Delay Supply Charges and rebates
Distinguishing between probable and possible exposures for revenue adjustment vs contingent liability disclosure
Inherent risk of revenue being overstated
Related party transactions with Aminova Infusions Pvt Ltd where KMP exercises significant influence
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions with Aminova Infusions Pvt Ltd (entity where Whole-Time Director Mr. Shailendra Pathak is promoter and majority shareholder) approved for aggregate limit of ₹8.00 crore (increased from ₹5.00 crore) for two-year tenure. Transactions include salary payments to KMPs: Mr. Sanjay Sethi (MD) ₹21.00 lakh, Ms. Neha Sharma (CS) ₹1.50 lakh, Mr. Ashish Baraskar (CFO) ₹12.00 lakh, Mr. Shailendra Pathak (WTD) ₹12.00 lakh, Mr. Kamlesh Gupta (CS) ₹3.00 lakh. Sitting fees paid to directors: Mr. Sudhir Sethi ₹0.60 lakh, Mr. Abhinav Naik ₹0.90 lakh, Mrs. Shreya Saraf ₹0.90 lakh, Mrs. Neha Sarda ₹0.30 lakh.
